messages:
violet: Quick heads-up — cutoff for v2.5.1 is today 18:00 UTC. Please get version-bump PRs in and changelog entries added. I'll start the green-sweep at ~18:10. @morgan @leo

sam: On it. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/repo/pull/1987 (version bump + changelog). Needs one more review.

morgan: LGTM, leaving a couple nits. CI looks flaky on mac tests though — saw a launcher timeout.

ci-bot: Pipeline #4672: macos-integration failed on test 'launcher/restart.test' (flaky). Retry available.

leo: I can look. Is this the same failure as last week? Stack shows a spawn timeout in subprocess.

dana: If it's flaky, let's mark it with @pytest.mark.flaky for now and skip in the green-sweep? We should triage properly tomorrow.

violet: Prefer not to change tests in the release window unless necessary. Can someone rerun the mac pipeline once? If it's green, we'll include the PR.

sam: Re-run triggered: `./scripts/ci retry 4672`

ci-bot: Re-run started. ETA ~8m.

ci-bot: Re-run complete: macos-integration passed. All other jobs green. :tada:

morgan: :thumbsup: merging after one more approval. @violet do you want me to squash?

violet: Yes please squash and merge. Don't forget to update CHANGELOG under Unreleased > Fixes with a one-liner.

leo: Also a tagging reminder: after merge run `git tag -a v2.5.1 -m 'v2.5.1' && git push origin v2.5.1` (or use the release job).

dana: I'll post the release note draft in #product after merge. Congrats team :party_parrot: 

sam: Merged and pushed tag. Release job started: https://ci.internal/builds/4678

ci-bot: Release job finished: success. Release artifact uploaded.

violet: Thanks everyone. Follow-up: create a short postmortem on the flaky mac launcher test (assign to @morgan). I'll reopen the triage ticket if we see regressions.

leo: Filed ticket RED-3124 with logs and timeout thresholds. Assigning to @morgan for next-week deep dive.

sam: Nice work, green-sweep successful. :rocket:
